attribution_rules: If ORACLE passes and LIVE fails, attribute primary cause upstream unless target-node deterministic contract is violated.
If ORACLE and LIVE both fail on the same target node, attribute primary cause to target node/prompt candidate.
If MUTATED fails in the expected safe direction, count robustness PASS; blindly accepting the mutation is robustness FAIL.
Do not mix ORACLE and LIVE averages.
